title: chore(helper): replace helper.clearRefinements
body:

<!--

IFW-978

`helper.clearRefinements` (in refine) clears *all* refinements; not just the one from this widget itself and this can have unexpected side-effects.

This change replaces it by a `removeXFacetRefinement` or similar, which leaves the state in place.
